classes.name: Pedestrian Crossing
classes.description: Warns drivers that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Drivers must yield.

classes.name: No Left Turn
classes.description: Prohibits vehicles from making a left turn at the specified intersection.

classes.name: No Right Turn
classes.description: Prohibits vehicles from making a right turn at the specified intersection.

classes.name: No Entry
classes.description: Indicates no vehicular access is permitted in this direction.

classes.name: Speed Limit (20 km/h)
classes.description: Maximum permitted vehicle speed is 20 kilometers per hour.

classes.name: No Parking
classes.description: Parking of vehicles is prohibited in this designated zone.

classes.name: No Stopping
classes.description: Stopping and waiting are strictly prohibited at all times.

classes.name: No Overtaking
classes.description: Passing or overtaking other motor vehicles is forbidden.

classes.name: Stop
classes.description: Drivers must come to a complete stop before proceeding safely.

classes.name: Children Crossing
classes.description: Warns of potential presence of children near schools or playgrounds.
